English page ku.dk/studies/meet-ucph/open-house-bachelor: 'See you again for Open House 2027' (event itself in Danish).

title: Studiepraktik at KU (uge 43)
quote: I 2026 foregår studiepraktik i 2-3 dage i hele landet: 21. oktober til 23. oktober i uge 43.
notes: For 3.g students/sabbatical; register via studiepraktik.dk (deadline 14 Sep passed). Page: vacant places released first-come from 29 Sep kl. 12.

title: Studerende for en dag
quote: Du kan komme på besøg i perioder, hvor der er undervisning.
notes: Year-round 2-4 hour visit shadowing a bachelor student; fill in form and a student host contacts you to agree a date. Limited in exam periods (Jan, May, Dec) and summer.

title: StudieInfo (online national study-choice event, KU participates)
quote: Deltag selv (dig, der holder sabbatår eller uden din klasse) D. 22. april fra kl. 17 til 18
notes: precedent - 2026-27 not yet announced; pattern: April online event (class sessions weeks 16-18). Page gives no year; date assumed April 2026. Aimed at 2.g/sabbatical students; chat with current students.

title: Åbent Hus på DTU (Open House, all BSc Eng and BEng programmes)
place: DTU Lyngby Campus, Anker Engelunds Vej 101, 2800 Kgs. Lyngby
quote: Torsdag den 4. marts 2027 er der Åbent Hus på DTU Lyngby Campus.
notes: Full programme published later; optional sign-up for programme info. English page aabenthus.dtu.dk/praktisk-information/info-in-english: event mainly in Danish, but General Engineering (English-taught BSc) students/teachers can be met and facilities seen on two guided tours. Precedent 2026: 5 Mar 12:00-19:00 (dtu.dk/english/calendar-archive/2026/03/aabent-hus-paa-dtu-eng).

title: Studiepraktik på DTU (uge 43)
notes: Registration via studiepraktik.dk (national deadline was 14 Sep 2026; vacant places first-come afterwards per national scheme). Danish-taught programmes.

title: Studerende for en dag på DTU
quote: Du kan blive Studerende for en dag på de fleste af vores diplomingeniør- og civilbachelorretninger.
notes: Register via form; a student 'Dagguide' contacts you to agree a date: campus tour, lecture, study environment. Only in teaching periods; not May/December (exams), limited Jan/Jun-Aug. English guided-tours page points BSc prospects here; contact studvejl@adm.dtu.dk.

title: Gå-ruter: self-guided campus walking routes (Lyngby and Ballerup)
place: DTU Lyngby Campus and DTU Ballerup Campus
quote: Du kan bruge gå-ruterne i DTU's åbningstid på hverdage fra kl. 08.00 til 16.00.
notes: Self-guided routes designed by Study Guidance, usable whenever it suits; English version at dtu.dk/english/education/get-to-know-us/walking-routes-on-campus. Staffed guided tours (english guided-tours page) are for prospective MSc students only.

notes: Event language 'English and Danish'; same programme as 24 Feb 2027. Programme to be published in November (page says 'during November 2027', apparently a typo). International Lounge for international applicants; CBS can sign an absence form for school.

title: Studiepraktik på Roskilde Universitet (uge 43)
quote: Du kan søge en ledig plads fra 29. september 2026 til og med 16. oktober 2026
notes: Start: 21. okt kl. 09.00, Slut: 22. okt kl. 16.00. Main application window 5-14 Sep 2026 via studiepraktik.dk; vacant places first-come 29 Sep - 16 Oct 2026. Offered on Samfundsvidenskabelig, Humanistisk and Naturvidenskabelig Bachelor/International Bachelor in Natural Sciences.
